mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tracking_event_record WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND server_time >= CURDATE() AND server_time < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tracking_event_record WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND server_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)) AS successCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tracking_event_reject_record WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND server_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)) AS rejectCount

WITH success_stats AS ( SELECT event_name, SUM(CASE WHEN server_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_count, SUM(CASE WHEN server_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 48 HOUR) AND server_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS previous_count FROM tracking_event_record WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND server_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 48 HOUR) GROUP BY event_name ), reject_stats AS ( SELECT event_name, COUNT(1) AS reject_count FROM tracking_event_reject_record WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND server_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND event_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_name ), latency_rank AS ( SELECT event_name, GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, FROM_UNIXTIME(event_time / 1000.0), server_time) / 1000, 0) AS latency_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_name ORDER BY GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, FROM_UNIXTIME(event_time / 1000.0), server_time) / 1000, 0)) AS row_no, COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY event_name) AS total_count FROM tracking_event_record WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND server_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) ), latency_stats AS ( SELECT event_name, MAX(CASE WHEN row_no = CEIL(total_count * 0.95) THEN ROUND(latency_ms) END) AS p95_latency FROM latency_rank GROUP BY event_name ), all_events AS ( SELECT event_name FROM success_stats UNION SELECT event_name FROM reject_stats ) SELECT events.event_name AS eventName, IFNULL(success.current_count, 0) AS currentCount, IFNULL(success.previous_count, 0) AS previousCount, IFNULL(rejects.reject_count, 0) AS rejectCount, IFNULL(latency.p95_latency, 0) AS p95Latency FROM all_events events LEFT JOIN success_stats success ON success.event_name = events.event_name LEFT JOIN reject_stats rejects ON rejects.event_name = events.event_name LEFT JOIN latency_stats latency ON latency.event_name = events.event_name ORDER BY currentCount DESC, events.event_name

SELECT releases.version_no AS versionNo, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(releases.publish_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS publishTime FROM ( SELECT version AS version_no, publish_time FROM app_version WHERE status != 5 AND publish_time IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT version AS version_no, create_time AS publish_time FROM app_version_control WHERE status = 0 AND create_time IS NOT NULL ) releases WHERE releases.version_no IS NOT NULL AND releases.version_no != '' GROUP BY releases.version_no ORDER BY MAX(releases.publish_time) DESC LIMIT 5
